THE CALLER STATES THAT FIRST RESPONDERS ARE ON SCENE TO SHUT OFF THE PIPELINE, EXTINGUISH THE FIRE, SECURE THE BUILDING AND TRANSPORT THE INJURED PARTIES.

SkyTruth Analysis

Report Description
OPERATIONS PERSONNEL DISCOVERED AN OIL SHEEN WITHIN THE PROCESS WASTEWATER SYSTEM OF THE THERMAL PLANT LOCATED AT THE REFERENCED ADDRESS. AT 11:11 A.M. CDT PERSONNEL THEN CHECKED THE RECEIVING STREAM FOR THE PROCESS WASTE WATER SYSTEM (BRAYS BAYOU) AND OBSERVED A VISIBLE OIL SHEEN. PERSONNEL THEN ACTED TO CONTROL DISCHARGE OF OIL FROM THE FACILITY BY STOPPING AS MUCH PROCESS WASTEWATER FLOW AS POSSIBLE AND DEPLOYING OIL ABSORBING DEVICES WITHIN THE PROCESS WASTEWATER SYSTEM'S DETENTION PITS. PERSONNEL THEN BEGAN PUMPING THE DETENTION PITS TO AN ONSITE PROCESS BASIN THAT IS CURRENTLY OFFLINE. AT 1:45 P.M. COT, PERSONNEL OBSERVED THAT THERE WAS NO LONGER AN OIL SHEEN ON BRAYS BAYOU. TOTAL RELEASE VOLUME IS UNKNOWN BUT ESTIMATED TO BE LESS THAN 55 GALLONS.

PERSONNEL THEN ACTED TO CONTROL DISCHARGE OF OIL FROM THE FACILITY BY STOPPING AS MUCH PROCESS WASTEWATER FLOW AS POSSIBLE AND DEPLOYING OIL ABSORBING DEVICES WITHIN THE PROCESS WASTEWATER SYSTEM'S DETENTION PITS. PERSONNEL THEN BEGAN PUMPING THE DETENTION PITS TO AN ONSITE PROCESS BASIN THAT IS CURRENTLY OFFLINE. AT 1:45 P.M. COT, PERSONNEL OBSERVED THAT THERE WAS NO LONGER AN OIL SHEEN ON BRAYS BAYOU. TOTAL RELEASE VOLUME IS UNKNOWN BUT ESTIMATED TO BE LESS THAN 55 GALLONS.

properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 1316653 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: M&H VALVE COMPANY
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1316653
Incident Time: 2021-09-13 15:30:00
Nearest City: Anniston, AL
Location: 605 W 23RD STREET
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: TRANSMISSION FLUID
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: M&H VALVE COMPANY
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 33.675186, -85.839216 (Approximated from premise)
Reported Spill Volume: 8 gallon
Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT A FORKLIFT RELEASED 6 GALLONS OF HYDRAULIC OIL AND 2 GALLONS OF TRANSMISSION FLUID ONTO THE GROUND AND IN A STORM DRAIN. ACCORDING TO THE CALLER THE MATERIAL WAS ABLE TO BE CONTAINED IN THE STORM DRAIN. THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE WAS DUE TO RUNNING OVER A PIECE OF METAL, WHICH CUT THE HOSES THAT RELEASED THE MATERIALS. THE MATERIAL WAS COLLECTED OUT OF THE CONTAINED STORM DRAIN. AT 1530 HOURS A LOCAL STORM WASHED THE RESIDUAL MATERIAL THROUGH THE STORM WATER PIPING NETWORK TO AN UNNAMED TRIBUTARY OF SNOW CREEK. THE STORM CONCLUDED AT 1630 HOURS, WITH A MEASUREMENT 0.04 INCHES OF RAIN. AT THE START OF THE EVENT THE CALLER DEPLOYED OIL ABSORBENT CONTROLS AT THE DISCHARGE POINT TO MITIGATE THE SHEEN LEAVING THE DISCHARGE POINT. THE CALLER THEN DEPLOYED ADDITIONAL ABSORBENTS IN THE PIPING SYSTEM AND DOWNSTREAM OF THE CREEK AND VERIFIED NO SHEENS WERE PRESENT PAST THE CONTROLS PUT IN PLACE.

properties.content:
Report Details

Location2: INTERNATIONAL BRIDGE INTO THE ST LAWRENCE RIVER

Medium Affected: WATER

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 45.004639, -74.740869 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionREPORTS CONTRACTOR ON THE INTERNATIONAL BRIDGE DUMPED STONES INTO THE RIVER. THEY WERE CLEAN STONES. AT 200 AKWESANE INTERNATIONAL RD, CORNWALL ON CONTRACTOR IS BRONTE CONSTRUCTION SHOULD HAVE KNOWN BETTER. REPORTING PARTY STATED THEY HAVE A TRAVELLER SYSTEM, A RAILWAY CAR UNDER THE BRIDGE WAS INSTALLED. THEY HAD TO PUT WEIGHT ON IT 3000 POUNDS TO SEE HOW IT WOULD RUN. THE CONTRACTOR WAS UNLOADING THE STONE, SOME BAGS BROKE OPEN, IT WAS COLD OUT AND PROBABLY DIDN"T WANT TO DEAL WITH IT, SO THEY JUST OPENED THE BAGS AND LET THEM GO IN THE RIVER. THE RIVER IS THE ST LAWRENCE RIVER AND SOME WENT ON TO THE GROUND AS WELL. INTERNATIONAL PROPERTY SOME IN CANADA AND SOME IN US, THE US HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED. THE STONES ARE GONE IN THE RIVER ( UNRECOVERABLE) AND THE ONES ON LAND WILL BE PICKED UP. BRONTE CONSTRUCTION WAS SPOKEN TO AND WILL NOT DO THIS AGAIN. THIS WAS DONE ON MARCH 2, 2022, THREE DIFFERENT INCIDENTS: NORTH TRAVELLER AT 11:30 CENTRE TRAVELLER AT 13:30 SOUTH TRAVELLER AT 14:30 ENGINEER FIRM CAME TO INSPECT THE TRAVELLERS AND SEND IN PICTURES. FULL CAMERAS AND VIDEO OF THE INCIDENT. REPORTING PARTY NOTICED THE STONES IN THE PICTURES AND WENT BACK CHECKED VIDEO. HARBOUR SIDE ENGINEERING WITNESSED IT TOO. NOTIFICATION BECAUSE BRONTE CONSTRUCTION IS DENYING EVERYTHING. NO VISUAL IMPAIRMENTS TO ANYTHING IN THE WATER, WILDLIFE OR FISH WERE NOTICED.
